title: Single-cell and spatial omics of metabolic-immune ecosystems in prostate cancer: from androgen signaling to therapy resistance.

title: Integrative single-cell eQTL and multi-omics analyses reveal AIM1 and ANXA1 as immune-related hub genes and potential therapeutic targets in head and neck cancer.
snippet: Head and neck cancer (HNC) is characterized by substantial immune heterogeneity and limited availability of clinically actionable molecular targets.
